faq.a: Yes. Daytime air temperatures average 15-18°C, and the sea is around 16°C. Sunny spells are common, and with a heated cabin or flybridge, you stay comfortable. Bring a light jacket for the breeze.

data.body_html:
December in Marbella offers a unique opportunity for a Marbella boat rental weather December 2026 experience: mild temperatures, calm seas, and a festive atmosphere in Puerto Banús. While summer crowds have gone, the Mediterranean remains inviting with sea temperatures around 16°C and air temperatures of 15-18°C. This guide covers what to expect, which yachts suit winter cruising, and how to make the most of your charter.

December Weather in Marbella: What to Expect

December is one of the mildest winter months on the Costa del Sol. Average daily highs reach 18°C, with lows around 10°C. You'll enjoy 7-8 hours of sunshine, and rainfall is limited to about 40mm spread over a few days. Winds are typically 10-15 knots, creating gentle swells in Marbella bay. The sea temperature averages 16°C — cool but refreshing for a short dip if you're brave.

Best Yachts for a Winter Charter

For comfort in cooler weather, choose a yacht with a heated interior or flybridge. Our top recommendations for December:

  • Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) — spacious saloon with heating, panoramic windows, and a protected flybridge.
  • Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) — open or grey variant, both with a large cabin and free jet ski included from €4,719 for 4 hours.
  • Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) — ultimate luxury with full winter amenities; pricing on request.
  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) — affordable option from €749/2h, ideal for a short festive cruise.

All depart from Puerto Banús and include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks.

Why Charter a Boat in December?

December offers several advantages: fewer boats on the water, more flexible booking times, and lower demand. The marina is decorated with Christmas lights, and you can combine a cruise with a visit to the Golden Mile or Marbella Old Town. Sunset is around 18:00, so an afternoon charter (e.g., 14:00-18:00) works perfectly.

Popular routes include cruising to Cabopino or Estepona, or anchoring near Cala del Faro for a quiet lunch. The calm seas make for a smooth ride.

Pricing and Inclusions

Our December rates are the same as the rest of the year. Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) cost €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours. The Mangusta 80 starts at €4,719 for 4 hours, including a free jet ski. All other yachts are priced on request via WhatsApp.

Every charter includes: licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden fees.

What to Wear and Bring

Dress in layers: a long-sleeve shirt, a fleece or light jumper, and a windproof jacket. Sunglasses and sunscreen are still useful — the sun reflects off the water. Non-slip shoes are recommended. The boat's cabin is heated, so you can warm up inside. Bring a camera for the stunning coastal views and festive marina lights.

Booking Tips for December 2026

Christmas and New Year's weeks are popular, so book early. Contact us via WhatsApp to check availability and secure your preferred yacht. We recommend the Azimut 58 Flybridge for families or groups of up to 12, or the Mangusta 80 for a luxurious experience with added water sports.

For a shorter trip, the Astondoa 40 is ideal for a 2-hour sunset cruise. All bookings are confirmed with a deposit; the balance is due on the day.
